title: AnalyzeRequest
description: Request payload for POST /api/analyze endpoint. Accepts Solidity sourceCode, contractAddress, or both. Must provide at least one non-empty value.

sourceCode.description: Solidity source code content to analyze. Must contain non-whitespace characters. Maximum 204,800 characters (character count in JSON; HTTP body byte size is checked separately at runtime).

contractAddress.description: Avalanche Fuji target contract address (0x-prefixed 40 hex characters, excluding zero address).
